title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

title: Severance
tagline: There's more to work than life.
overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
creator: Dan Erickson

episodes.title: Good News About Hell
episodes.overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: Half Loop
episodes.overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
episodes.overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.title: The You You Are
episodes.overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
episodes.overview: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
episodes.overview: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.title: The We We Are
episodes.overview: The team discovers troubling revelations.

episodes.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.overview: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.overview: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.title: Who Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.title: Woe's Hollow
episodes.overview: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.title: Trojan's Horse
episodes.overview: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.title: Attila
episodes.overview: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.title: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.overview: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.title: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.overview: Discoveries are made.

episodes.title: The After Hours
episodes.overview: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.title: Cold Harbor
episodes.overview: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

title: Blade Runner 2049
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

title: Shōgun
tagline: An epic saga of war, passion, and power set in Feudal Japan.
overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.
creator: Rachel Kondo

episodes.title: Anjin
episodes.overview: Destinies converge in Japan after a barbarian ship washes ashore in a poor fishing village. Meanwhile, in Osaka, Lord Toranaga finds himself outplayed by his enemies.

episodes.title: Servants of Two Masters
episodes.overview: Blackthorne's arrival in Osaka stirs up a hornet's nest of rivalries. Mariko is trapped between her cause and her faith when she must translate for the barbarian in Lord Toranaga's custody.

episodes.title: Tomorrow Is Tomorrow
episodes.overview: After Blackthorne survives a brazen assassination attempt, Toranaga realizes he must ferry his allies out of Osaka or risk certain defeat.

episodes.title: The Eightfold Fence
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko test their new alliance as they train Toranaga's gun regiment for war. Yabushige must navigate his past promises to Ishido when an old friend comes to the village.

episodes.title: Broken to the Fist
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko struggle to contain the secret that could get them both killed. Yabushige searches for the spy who has betrayed his intentions to Lord Toranaga.

episodes.title: Ladies of the Willow World
episodes.overview: Lady Ochiba returns to Osaka in order to accelerate the Regents' campaign against Toranaga. In Ajiro, Toranaga tests Mariko's loyalty to his cause.

episodes.title: A Stick of Time
episodes.overview: Outplayed by new alliances in Osaka, Toranaga is forced to carve out a new deal with a long lost family member.

episodes.title: The Abyss of Life
episodes.overview: Toranaga's defeated clan moves to Edo and awaits their fate. Blackthorne must decide who he fights for - the lord who has turned his back on him, or the ambition that brought him to Japan in the first place.

episodes.title: Crimson Sky
episodes.overview: Mariko arrives in Osaka for the fight of her life. Blackthorne and Yabushige scramble to save their own heads as their options dwindle.

episodes.title: A Dream of a Dream
episodes.overview: In the wake of a tragic death, Blackthorne finally considers the true nature of Toranaga's plan.

title: Interstellar
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

title: The Batman
overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

title: The Bear
overview: Carmy, a young fine-dining chef, comes home to Chicago to run his family sandwich shop. As he fights to transform the shop and himself, he works alongside a rough-around-the-edges crew that ultimately reveal themselves as his chosen family.
creator: Christopher Storer

episodes.title: System
episodes.overview: Carmy attempts to retrain the employees of The Original Beef of Chicagoland, but is faced with resistance; in need of back-up, he brings on a talented young chef to help.

episodes.title: Hands
episodes.overview: A surprise health inspection reveals the cracks in the restaurant's foundation. Carmy goes head-to-head with Richie.

episodes.title: Brigade
episodes.overview: Carmy attends Al-Anon. Sydney struggles to gain the respect of the staff.

episodes.title: Dogs
episodes.overview: Carmy and Richie cater a kid's birthday party. Tina and Sydney work together while Marcus makes donuts.

episodes.title: Sheridan
episodes.overview: Things go wrong in the kitchen. Sydney finds solutions.

episodes.title: Ceres
episodes.overview: Richie notices the neighborhood is changing. Sugar and Carmy clean up the office.

episodes.title: Review
episodes.overview: A bad day in the kitchen causes tensions to rise.

episodes.title: Braciole
episodes.overview: Things get out of control. Carmy is faced with a decision.

episodes.title: Beef
episodes.overview: Faced with the reality of opening a new restaurant, the crew must make a plan.

episodes.title: Pasta
episodes.overview: The crew splits up to work towards their new vision.

episodes.title: Sundae
episodes.overview: Sydney searches Chicago for culinary inspiration.

episodes.title: Honeydew
episodes.overview: Marcus challenges himself.

episodes.title: Pop
episodes.overview: The renovation gets off track.

episodes.title: Fishes
episodes.overview: Feast of the Seven Fishes.

episodes.title: Forks
episodes.overview: Richie stages.

episodes.title: Bolognese
episodes.overview: The crew awaits a do-or-die fire suppression test.

episodes.title: Omelette
episodes.overview: Final preparations are made for The Bear's first service.

episodes.title: The Bear
episodes.overview: Friends & Family night at The Bear.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
tagline: The future belongs to the mad.
overview: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

title: Arrival
overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.

title: Arcane
overview: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

cast.name: JB Blanc
cast.character: Bolbok (voice), Vander (voice), Bolbok / Vander (voice), Vander / Warwick (voice) and 1 more...

creator: Christian Linke

episodes.title: Welcome to the Playground
episodes.overview: Orphaned sisters Vi and Powder bring trouble to Zaun's underground streets in the wake of a heist in posh Piltover.

episodes.title: Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved
episodes.overview: Idealistic inventor Jayce attempts to harness magic through science—despite his mentor's warnings. Criminal kingpin Silco tests a powerful substance.

episodes.title: The Base Violence Necessary for Change
episodes.overview: An epic showdown between old rivals results in a fateful moment for Zaun. Jayce and Viktor risk it all for their research.

episodes.title: Happy Progress Day!
episodes.overview: With Piltover prospering from their tech, Jayce and Viktor weigh their next move. A familiar face re-emerges from Zaun to wreak havoc.

episodes.title: Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy
episodes.overview: Rogue enforcer Caitlyn tours the undercity to track down Silco. Jayce puts a target on his back trying to root out Piltover corruption.

episodes.title: When These Walls Come Tumbling Down
episodes.overview: An eager protégé undermines his mentor on the council as a magical tech rapidly evolves. With authorities in pursuit, Jinx must face her past.

episodes.title: The Boy Savior
episodes.overview: Caitlyn and Vi meet an ally in Zaun’s streets and head into a frenzied battle with a common foe. Viktor makes a dire decision.

episodes.title: Oil and Water
episodes.overview: Disowned heir Mel and her visiting mother trade combat tactics. Caitlyn and Vi forge an unlikely alliance. Jinx undergoes a startling change.

episodes.title: The Monster You Created
episodes.overview: Perilously close to war, the leaders of Piltover and Zaun reach an ultimatum. But a fateful standoff changes both cities forever.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.
overview: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
tagline: Feel the need... The need for speed.
overview: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.

title: La La Land
tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.
overview: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

title: The Dark Knight
tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Inception
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

title: Sintel
overview: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.

title: Attack on Titan
tagline: Home was a pen. Humanity, cattle.
overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!

episodes.title: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina (1)
episodes.overview: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

episodes.title: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina (2)
episodes.overview: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

episodes.title: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback (1)
episodes.overview: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertolt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

title: SPY x FAMILY
tagline: The father... a spy. The mother... an assassin. The daughter... a telepath.
overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.

episodes.title: OPERATION STRIX
episodes.overview: Twilight, an agent of Westalis's intelligence agency, disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya to get closer to his target. Unbeknownst to him, Anya can read minds.

episodes.title: SECURE A WIFE
episodes.overview: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Meanwhile, Loid is searching for someone to play Anya's mother for the interview at Eden College.

episodes.title: PREPARE FOR THE INTERVIEW
episodes.overview: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview, so Loid decides they should all go out as a family.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
tagline: The love of a brother transcends everything.
overview: After a demon attack leaves his family slain and his sister cursed, Tanjiro embarks upon a perilous journey to find a cure and avenge those he's lost.

episodes.title: Cruelty
episodes.overview: Tanjiro Kamado returns from selling charcoal in town to find his family slaughtered by a demon. He rushes down the snowy mountain with the sole survivor, his sister Nezuko, on his back.

episodes.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
episodes.overview: At Giyu Tomioka's urging, Tanjiro heads for Mt. Sagiri with Nezuko, and comes face to face with a man-eating demon on the way.

episodes.title: Sabito and Makomo
episodes.overview: Sakonji Urokodaki trains Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the Demon Slayer Corps, and sets him one last hurdle in front of a giant boulder.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
tagline: A boy fights... for "the right death."
overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

episodes.title: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.overview: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

episodes.title: For Myself
episodes.overview: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.overview: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

title: Naruto Shippūden
overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.overview: A figure passes through the gates. It's an older Naruto, who has returned from a long training journey with Jiraiya. Naruto Uzumaki is back!

episodes.title: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sakura team up and challenge Kakashi to a survival challenge to show off their progress.

episodes.title: The Results of Training
episodes.overview: Naruto's and Sakura's combined skills force Kakashi to use his Sharingan right off the bat. Naruto masterfully unleashes his jutsu one after another.
